chapter_title: 第三十二章 消化器病 (Siau-hòa-khì-pīⁿ)
text:
### Tē 457 tô͘

Tē 457 tô͘.—Seng-khu-lāi ê chōng-khì tùi tò-pêng khòaⁿ ê tô͘: lék-sek-ê sī hì kap heng-mo̍h; âng-sek-ê sī ūi; o͘-sek-ê sī pî-chōng; pî-chōng ê ē-tóe sī hā-hêng-kiat-tn̂g. (From Hutchison and Rainy's "Clinical Methods," Cassell and Co., publishers.)

> **【全漢對照】**
> 第 457 圖。——身軀內的臟器對倒爿看的圖：綠色的是肺佮胸膜；紅色的是胃；黑色的是脾臟；脾臟的下底是下行結腸。(From Hutchison and Rainy's "Clinical Methods," Cassell and Co., publishers.)
